findings.text: The negative control is no longer asserted. Commit 50ea2595 removed `assert max(unbounded_p90) > 45.0`; the head test computes unbounded_p90 only for the failure message and asserts just the bounded arm, so at margin 2.6 the bound-disabled arm crosses 45 s on seeds 0, 1, 2 and 4 only. On seeds 3, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 9 the bounded arm's `< 45 s` passes whether or not the bound does anything that changes the maximum, so for those seeds the test cannot distinguish a working bound from an absent one. The closure assertion (`assert closed`) does fire on every seed, which partly compensates. The fragment records the per-seed crossing honestly, so the pass condition (the bounded arm) is still asserted; this is a weaker negative control than the plan's done-when names, not a false claim.

The fragment's `Logs:` line cites logs/margin-seeds.log, logs/s5-probe-early3.log and logs/s5-gate.log, but none of these carries the ten-seed margin-2.6 figures the table shows. margin-seeds.log is at revision 4f148397 at margins 2.7 and 2.8 (seed 1 bounded 45.25 s at 2.7, 48.25 s at 2.8), and s5-probe-early3.log is the base-revision early-think probe at 35.25 s; the table's seed 0 (unbounded 47.00 s, bounded 34.50 s) matches logs/margin-final-ten-seeds.log at margin 2.6. A reader following the citation reaches numbers that disagree with the table. The correct log is recorded in the reviewed manifest's test_logs and seed_gate_log; the citation, not the measurement, is wrong.

reuse_search.judgement: The node hoisted one estimator, lane_utilisation.percentile_or_none, and made the gate bound, the evidence window and lane_sim._quantile all call it, so the lane's percentile has a single owner. The nearest-rank helpers that exist elsewhere (bench_report._percentile, data/probe._percentile) are module-private in unrelated subsystems with different formulas (int(n*q) and round-based) and are not the owner of the lane's gate-wait figure; receipt_bins.inclusive_quantile is interpolated, not nearest-rank. The closure and the wait-scaled capacity extend _AdmissionLedger, which already owns capacity and slots; no second closure mechanism was added.
